simulator.method: One 10000-event batch for origin/main and patched simulator in the same built worker, same full products/users and seed 42; isolated SQLite directories and Redis namespaces; simulator service paused. Cleanup excluded from timing.
simulator.interval_semantics: Batch-start interval; a batch taking longer than 1 second is followed immediately, not one extra second later.

latency.simulator_running: Separate smoke_live_simulator.json verifies functional integration; latency benchmark was not repeated under continuous simulator load.

ab.interpretation: Synthetic negative lift, preserved as measured; output verification PASS does not mean recommendation effectiveness improved.
